question: Does AS5650 sold as Verizon by AaITR announce its prefixes under Frontier Communications, and what usage class do the vendor's published test addresses read in a lookup instrument?
why: the vendor labels AS5650 'Verizon' while RIPE Stat holds it as FRONTIER-FRTR; the test addresses are on an account-only page, so no address was looked up (rung 5 unverified)
